title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
requirement: Makes it an unlawful antitrust violation for rental property owners to pay for or use a coordinator's services, for coordinators to facilitate rent-fixing agreements, for anyone to engage in parallel pricing coordination, or for any person to perform a coordinating function (algorithmic setting or recommending of rents, lease terms or occupancy using competitors' nonpublic information). Municipalities may not enact conflicting ordinances.
penalty: Violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act; enforcement under sections 6 through 17 of P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-6 through 9-17).
status_basis: Approved July 20, 2026; takes effect the first day of the twelfth month next following enactment.

title: New Jersey Security Deposit Law
requirement: Landlords may collect a security deposit of at most 1.5 times one month's rent, with yearly increases capped at 10% of the current deposit. penalty: If the tenant does not get proper notice or interest, the tenant may apply the deposit plus 7% per annum interest to rent.

requirement: A landlord may recover possession of a residential unit only by consent or through court eviction, and must have good cause (statutory grounds). requirement: Housing providers may not ask about an applicant's criminal record until after a conditional offer.
